name: Protection / Warning
description: Fear → relief. Warns the viewer about what a bad provider does, then shows the business as the safe choice. Fills Trust slots.

name: Education / Authority
description: Curiosity → capability. Teaches something the viewer did not know, which earns the right to sell later. Fills Awareness slots.

name: Social Proof / Trust
description: Credibility. Evidence that the business does what it claims — people, history, finished work. Fills Trust slots.

name: Business Showcase
description: Surprise / value. Shows the scale, range or price of what the business actually offers. Fills Awareness and Enquiry slots.

name: Pain Point → CTA
description: Relief → action. Names the buyer's frustration and answers it with a direct ask. Fills Enquiry and Conversion slots.

name: Behind the Business
description: Familiarity. Ordinary days, updates and the people behind the work — keeps an existing audience warm. Fills Engagement slots.
